prompts.title: 钟表匠文档板（分解图）
prompts.description: 一个提示模板，旨在为一款时计生成一个复杂的多段式文档板，其中融合了历史专利图纸、机芯的详细爆炸图（带有材料标注）以及成品腕表的特写肖像，并在整个板面上实现了视觉风格的过渡。
prompts.prompt: A master watchmaker's documentation board for {argument name="timepiece" default="a Tourbillon Chronograph"} — {argument name="manufacture" default="Patek Philippe"} / {argument name="complication" default="Perpetual Calendar"} / {argument name="year" default="1950"}. Left section: historical context showing the original patent drawings, period advertisements in gilded frames, and archival photographs of the atelier with craftsmen at work. Center section: the movement in exploded view, every wheel, spring, and jewel suspended in precise spatial relationship, with material callouts (Geneva stripes, blued screws, ruby bearings) and functional annotations tracing the flow of power from mainspring to escapement. Right section: the completed watch in its defining context—wrist of an explorer, pocket of a diplomat, or display case of a collector—captured with shallow depth and warm side lighting. Visual style transitions from sepia patent office to mechanical precision chrome to intimate portraiture. Title block reading "{argument name="watch name" default="[WATCH NAME]"} — CALIBRE {argument name="calibre number" default="[NUMBER]"}, {argument name="complication" default="[COMPLICATION]"}, CIRCA {argument name="year" default="[YEAR]"}".
